free_tier.stated: A free 10 GB test account: 'einen kostenlosen 10GB-Testaccount' after email confirmation and an SMS activation code; no cost and no cancellation needed.
free_tier.notes: The test needs an email address and a phone able to receive an SMS code.

retention.stated: Retention of up to over 1800 days

egress.terms: Prepaid volume blocks; the volume does not lapse at month end

chaining: The 10 GB test can be topped up in the customer center at any time; an unused account just rests, so the free 10 GB is a standing test of the service.

limits.value: 10 GB test account; paid blocks from 5 GB to 500 GB (third-party index)

limits_note: The vendor pages read show no block price; the 5 GB to 500 GB range and 10 connections are from a third-party index.
binding_note: Every product is a fixed number of GB, 10 GB in the free test.

identity_cost.detail: Registration sends a confirmation email and then an SMS code that unlocks the test ('erhalten Sie per SMS einen Freischaltcode'); no card is asked for the test and the vendor says it needs no bank or card data for prepaid purchases.

reliability_note: Backbone is not stated on the vendor pages read.
confidence_note: The test, retention and identity are from the vendor pages read on 2026-11-03; block prices are third-party.

evidence.quote: Sie haben dann einen kostenlosen 10GB-Testaccount, den Sie mit dem vollen Funktionsumfang von Prepaid-Usenet nutzen können.
evidence.proved: the test account carries 10 GB at no cost

evidence.quote: Nach der E-Mail-Bestätigung erhalten Sie per SMS einen Freischaltcode.
evidence.proved: the test needs an email confirmation and then an SMS activation code

evidence.quote: Wir bieten Ihnen als Usenet-Provider eine Retention, die Vorhaltezeit von Inhalten im Usenet, von bis über 1800 Tagen.
evidence.proved: retention is stated as up to over 1800 days

evidence.quote: Bei Prepaid-Usenet haben wir es nicht nötig Sie in eine Abofalle zu locken, welche sich hinter einem Testzugang versteckt. Testen Sie unseren Zugang kostenlos - ohne Kosten, ohne Kündigung, ohne Wenn und Aber.
evidence.proved: the test is free with no subscription behind it

evidence.quote: Wir benötigen keine Bankdaten, Lastschriftdaten oder Kreditkarte.
evidence.proved: prepaid purchases need no bank, direct-debit or card data

evidence.quote: Prepaid Usenet is a German provider based exclusively on prepaid data packages with no expiration — no subscription, no minimum term. Blocks from 5 GB to 500 GB, over 1,800 days retention, 10 connections, 256-bit SSL, 100,000+ newsgroups, EU servers, 10 GB demo via SMS. 14-day statutory right of withdrawal.
evidence.proved: a third-party index gives the block range 5 GB to 500 GB and 10 connections

notes: The free 10 GB is a one-off test, not a recurring allowance; the caveat is the SMS step and that the cheapest paid block price is third-party.
